full_locale_reuse_rule: For each of the 55 addon-owned full locales, reuse the exact G10 value only when both key and English value are unchanged. Drop removed keys. Use exact G11 target English for every added or changed meaning and for debug-only values unless a separately reviewed exact-target translation is introduced later.
supplement_rule: Fetch the immutable JEI 4.16.5 locale at the pinned commit and emit only exact missing normal keys. If a missing target key/value pair is unchanged from G10, recover the exact G10 combined locale value (G10 upstream plus project supplement, or G10 full addon locale). For added or changed meanings missing upstream, use exact G11 target English fallback.
network_reproducibility: Upstream ownership is read only from immutable raw.githubusercontent.com paths pinned by commit SHA. CI verifies exact missing-key ownership on every run.
debug_keys: description.jei.* keys remain exact target English in addon full files and are never emitted in missing-key supplements.
norwegian_policy: JEI 4.16.5 ships no_no directly. The previous nb_no mismatch is retired; no_no receives only its exact missing-key supplement.
release_rule: Minecraft 1.12.2 must receive its own dedicated JAR and must not be combined with Minecraft 1.12, 1.12.1 or another version.
